issues.jp_before: この電車[でんしゃ]{は|wa-topic}京都駅[きょうとえき]{にも|double-mo}止[と]まります。
issues.problem: Distractor でも is acceptable: 止まる takes both に and で for the stopping place (京都駅でも止まります is natural).
issues.action: Moved でも into the slot as an alternative ({にも/でも}); replaced distractor with へも; updated why.

issues.jp_before: 山[やま]{の|no-possessive}上[うえ]{からも|double-mo}海[うみ]{が|ga-sense}見[み]えます{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: Distractor でも (山の上でも海が見えますか) is natural with nearly the same meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor でも with へも.

issues.jp_before: 東京[とうきょう]{からも|double-mo}注文[ちゅうもん]{が|ga-existence}ありました。
issues.problem: Distractors でも/にも with a bare place name (東京でも注文がありました) give an acceptable reading of 'orders from Tokyo too'.
issues.action: Rewrote as 東京のお客さんからも注文がありました ('There were orders from customers in Tokyo too.'), f=1, so the source is a person and でも/にも are plainly wrong.
